summary.text: Scott Shamblin is the Republican candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Eliza Hamrick.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in the community he seeks to represent and has built businesses, led ministries and advocated for families at the State Capitol.

paragraphs.text: Shamblin advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary, and Ballotpedia lists his education as homeschooled and his profession as director of operations.
In his survey, he said his family sometimes relied on food banks while he was growing up and that he began working at 16.

Shamblin listed lowering the cost of living, holding violent criminals accountable, and government transparency and fiscal responsibility as key messages, and named affordability, public safety, parental rights and government accountability as his policy interests.
